cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance whose root node matches the supplied JSON schema
cases.description: Valid JSON schema string with default (null) configuration should be parsed and a JsonSchema object returned.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance whose ValidationContext is configured with failFast=true
cases.description: Valid JSON schema string together with a custom SchemaValidatorsConfig (failFast enabled) should be honoured by the created schema.
Passing a null schema string must result in an IllegalArgumentException (the factory cannot resolve a null location).
An empty schema string is not a valid location; the method should reject it with an IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or JsonProcessingException) indicating schema parsing failure
cases.description: A malformed JSON schema (unknown type) should cause a parsing/validation exception during schema creation.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance loaded from the remote URI (loader invoked)
cases.description: When the schema string is an absolute URI, the factory must resolve it via the SchemaLoader and return the corresponding JsonSchema.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema representing the Draft‑07 meta‑schema
cases.description: A known meta‑schema identifier should be recognised and the factory should return the built‑in meta‑schema object.

cases.expected: JsonProcessingException (or JsonSchemaException) because the default InputFormat.JSON cannot parse YAML content
cases.description: A schema supplied in YAML format should cause a parsing exception when the factory assumes JSON input.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema whose ValidationContext reports typeLoose=true
cases.description: When the config enables type‑loose mode, the created schema must carry that flag in its ValidationContext.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema whose ValidationContext has validateFormats=false (format validators are omitted)
cases.description: Disabling format validation via the config should result in a schema that does not enforce the "date-time" format.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema equivalent to calling the method with a null config (default behavior)
cases.description: Providing a freshly‑instantiated config with default values must behave the same as passing null.

group: JsonSchemaFactory.getSchema(String, SchemaValidatorsConfig) - resource resolution edge cases

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema loaded from the classpath resource (loader invoked)
cases.description: A schema string that refers to a classpath resource should be resolved by the SchemaLoader and result in a valid JsonSchema.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema loaded from the file URI (loader invoked)
cases.description: A schema string expressed as a file URI must be resolved via the loader and produce a schema instance.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance parsed successfully after trimming whitespace
cases.description: Leading/trailing whitespace and newline characters around a valid JSON schema string should be ignored and not cause an error.
A schema containing a $ref that cannot be resolved should cause schema loading to fail with an appropriate exception.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance; subsequent call with the same URI returns the same object (identity equality)
cases.description: When the same absolute URI is requested twice, the factory should return the cached JsonSchema instance rather than creating a new one.

cases.expected: JsonProcessingException (or JsonSchemaException) due to invalid JSON syntax
cases.description: A schema string that is syntactically invalid JSON (missing closing braces) should cause a parsing exception.
